'''Semalaren''' is a place in [[Seanchan]] where a battle was fought. [[Bakayar Mishima]] read that there were four hundred ''[[damane]]'' on either side and it was a slaughterhouse with half the Imperial army dead plus three out of four among the rebels{{ref/book|11|4}}.
